info.title: Market Data (EKS)
info.description: Realtime market quotes served by an internal service running on Amazon EKS, exposed to the agent platform as a governed MCP tool through the AgentCore Gateway. Reachable only through the Gateway (which injects the API key); never anonymously.

gatewayApiKey.name: x-agentcore-api-key
gatewayApiKey.description: Shared API key injected by the AgentCore Gateway API_KEY credential provider (never supplied by the model/caller). The EKS service validates it before returning any quote.

post.summary: Get realtime quotes for one or more tickers
post.description: Returns live bid/ask/last quotes for the requested symbols from the internal EKS market-data service. Provide a list of tickers (e.g. ['SPY','AGG','TLT']); defaults to a core basket if none given.

symbols.description: Tickers to quote, e.g. ['AAPL','MSFT','SPY']. Max 25; defaults to ['SPY','AGG','TLT'].

200.description: Realtime quotes for the requested symbols.
